appleAppStore.title: Sudojo - Learn Sudoku Techniques
appleAppStore.subtitle: Master 60+ Solving Strategies
appleAppStore.promotionalText: Master Sudoku from beginner to expert with 60+ solving techniques and intelligent hints.
appleAppStore.description:
Sudojo is the ultimate Sudoku learning platform that teaches you how to solve puzzles — not just gives you answers. Progress from beginner to expert through a structured belt system while mastering 60+ real solving techniques used by championship players.

DAILY CHALLENGES
• A fresh puzzle every day tailored to your skill level
• Track your daily streak and compete with yourself
• Share your completed puzzles with friends

LEARN 60 SOLVING TECHNIQUES
• Each technique includes step-by-step explanations and practice puzzles

Basics: Full House, Hidden Single, Naked Single
Pairs & Tuples: Hidden Pair, Naked Pair, Locked Candidates, Hidden Triple, Naked Triple, Hidden Quad, Naked Quad
Fish: X-Wing, Swordfish, Jellyfish, Squirmbag
Finned Fish: Finned X-Wing, Finned Swordfish, Finned Jellyfish, Finned Squirmbag
Sashimi Fish: Sashimi X-Wing, Sashimi Swordfish, Sashimi Jellyfish
Franken Fish: Franken X-Wing, Franken Swordfish, Franken Jellyfish
Wings: XY-Wing, XYZ-Wing, WXYZ-Wing, VWXYZ-Wing, UVWXYZ-Wing, TUVWXYZ-Wing, STUVWXYZ-Wing
Single-Digit Patterns: Skyscraper, Two-String Kite, Empty Rectangle, Simple Coloring, W-Wing, Remote Pairs, Crane, Firework
Unique Rectangles: Type 1, Type 2, Type 3, Type 4, Type 5, Hidden UR, Avoidable Rectangle
Almost Locked Sets: ALS, ALS-XZ, ALS Chain, Sue de Coq, Death Blossom
Chains: X-Cycles, Grouped X-Cycles, X-Chain, XY-Chain, AIC, Medusa Coloring, BUG+1, Forcing Chains, Forcing Net

SMART HINT SYSTEM
• Hints that teach you the technique, not just the answer
• Visual highlighting shows exactly which cells and candidates matter
• Step-by-step walkthrough of the solving logic
• Learn the "why" behind every move

BELT PROGRESSION SYSTEM
• 12 belt levels from White Belt (beginner) to Black Belt (master)
• Each belt introduces new techniques and harder puzzles
• Earn points, unlock badges, and track your improvement
• See your solving skills grow over time

12 DIFFICULTY LEVELS
• Beginner to Extreme — there's always a new challenge
• Each level focuses on specific techniques
• Free access to foundational levels
• Premium unlocks advanced and expert difficulties

MORE FEATURES
• Enter custom puzzles manually or scan from paper
• Multiple display modes: Numbers, Kanji (漢数字), or Emoji
• Pencil marks with auto-candidate mode
• Timer and error highlighting (optional)
• Dark mode and 16 language options
• Sync progress across devices with your account
• Works on iPhone, iPad, and Mac

FREE & PREMIUM
• Play daily puzzles and beginner-to-challenging levels for free
• Subscribe to unlock advanced levels, expert techniques, and full hint access
• Blue Belt: Unlocks Difficult, Intense, and Expert levels
• Red Belt: Unlocks all levels including Brutal and Brain Freeze

Whether you're picking up Sudoku for the first time or you're an experienced solver looking to learn advanced techniques, Sudojo is your path to mastery.

Terms of Use: https://sudojo.com/en/terms
Privacy Policy: https://sudojo.com/en/privacy
appleAppStore.whatsNew: Improved performance on technique details screen and fixed minor bugs.

summary.introduction: Sudojo ("we", "our", or "us") respects your privacy and is committed to protecting your personal data. This privacy policy explains how we collect, use, and safeguard your information when you use our application.

youProvide: Account information (email address, display name) when you create an account
Game progress, statistics, and puzzle completion data
User preferences and settings (theme, language, display mode)
Payment information processed through Apple App Store, Google Play, or Microsoft Store via RevenueCat
automaticallyCollected: Device information (model, OS version, screen size)
App usage patterns and feature interactions via Firebase Analytics
Crash reports and performance data via Firebase Crashlytics

howWeUse: Provide and improve the Sudoku learning experience
Analyze usage patterns to improve techniques and puzzles
Track points, badges, and level progression
summary.sharing: We do not sell your personal data. We share data only with service providers (Firebase, RevenueCat) necessary to operate the app, when required by law, or with your consent.
summary.security: We use encryption in transit (TLS) and at rest, conduct regular security assessments, employ access controls, and use secure cloud infrastructure.
summary.retention: We retain your information while your account is active. You can request deletion at any time by contacting privacy@sudojo.com.
summary.children: Our service is designed for users of all ages. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13 without verifiable parental consent. Users under 13 can use the app without creating an account.

summary.acceptance: By accessing or using Sudojo, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service.
summary.serviceDescription: Sudojo is a Sudoku learning application offering progressive learning with daily challenges, skill-based difficulty levels, 60+ solving techniques, and free and premium subscription tiers.
summary.accounts: You must provide accurate information, maintain account security, accept responsibility for activity under your account, and notify us of unauthorized access.
summary.acceptableUse: You agree not to circumvent subscriptions, use bots or automation, reverse engineer the app, share account credentials, or disrupt the service.
summary.subscriptions: Premium features are billed on a recurring basis. Subscriptions auto-renew unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Refunds follow the respective app store's refund policy.
summary.intellectualProperty: All content, features, puzzles, techniques, and design are owned by Sudobility and protected by copyright and trademark law.
summary.limitationOfLiability: The service is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind. We are not liable for indirect or consequential damages.
summary.termination: We may terminate accounts for violations of these terms. Users can delete their accounts at any time.
